title: Planning their Attack on Jabba's Palace
description: Boba Fett and Fennec Shand arrived at Bib Fortuna's palace by bantha, and employed the use of surveillance remotes to investigate and map out the palace. Fett freed his bantha friend shortly before the surveillance remotes returned. With the information gathered, Fett and Shand are able to confirm that his starship is still there. Timing the guards' patrol, they snuck in underneath the building.
